description: The lazy-client convenience: run the whole loop — discover → quote → appraise → decide → pay → ground — for a topic and return a grounded answer with cited, paid-for sources, the spend, the per-candidate decisions (with reasons), and the full decision log. Spend is bounded by the session budget. You MAY pass budgetUsdc to spend LESS on this run, but it is clamped to what remains in the session — you can lower the cap, never raise it. This SPENDS MONEY. Prefer the granular tools (naulon_discover, naulon_quote, naulon_pay_and_read) when you want to see prices and plan spend yourself before paying.

budgetUsdc.description: Optional cap for THIS run, in USDC. Clamped to the remaining session budget — lowers the cap only, never raises it.

name: naulon_research

answer.description: The grounded answer, citing the paid sources.

budget.description: The effective spend cap applied to this run (the clamped budget), in USDC.

ceilingUsdc.description: The server-configured session ceiling (cannot be raised from a tool).

log.description: The auditable, human-readable decision log for the run.

remainingUsdc.description: Budget left for this session (after this run).

requestedBudgetUsdc.description: The budgetUsdc you asked for, if it was clamped down to the remaining session budget.

settlement.description: The chain + token these tolls settled on. settlement.testnet true ⇒ play-money with no fiat value.

chainName.description: Human network name, e.g. arcTestnet / base.

explorer.description: Block-explorer origin for this chain when known — settlementRef is viewable at <explorer>/tx/<ref>. Omitted when no verified explorer exists for the chain.

network.description: CAIP-2 network id, e.g. eip155:5042002 (Arc Testnet) — the chain the toll settles on.

testnet.description: TRUE = testnet play-money with NO fiat value (faucet-funded); FALSE = real-money mainnet. Report this honestly — never call a testnet toll 'real money'.

token.description: The token every toll is paid in.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract address on this chain.

proofUrl.description: CITE THIS beside the source — the page a reader opens to see the author was paid.

recordUrl.description: The gate's permanent citation record for this settlement.

spent.description: Total actually spent on this run, in USDC.

spentSessionUsdc.description: Total spent across the whole MCP session (after this run).

title: Research a topic end-to-end (composite)
